name: Chancenkarte (Opportunity Card)

requirement_groups.name: Fully recognised foreign qualification (no points needed)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a foreign vocational qualification (2+ years) or university degree that is fully recognised in Germany.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for formal recognition of your qualification before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires German at A1 or English at B2.
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved language test at the required level.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires proof of funds of €13,092/year (€1,091/month, 2026 figure).
requirements.fix_path: Build the required savings or secure a formal funding/sponsorship declaration.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a foreign vocational qualification (2+ years) or university degree, at least partially recognised, plus German A1 or English B2.

value.note: minimum 6 points total across: partial qualification recognition (4), shortage occupation (1), professional experience (2 or 3), German/English level (1-3), age under 40 (1-2), prior German residence (1), partner co-applying (1)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires at least 6 points total under the official points table (qualification recognition, shortage occupation, professional experience, language level, age, prior residence in Germany, and partner co-application).
requirements.fix_path: Improve language level, gain more professional experience, or address other point-scoring factors before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires proof of funds of €13,092/year (€1,091/month, 2026 figure).
requirements.fix_path: Build the required savings or secure a formal funding/sponsorship declaration.

evidence_required.document: Qualification recognition certificate or partial-recognition notice
Proof of funds (blocked account, sponsorship declaration, or equivalent)

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year (Such-Chancenkarte), +2 further years (Folge-Chancenkarte) once a qualifying job offer is secured

sources.title: Opportunity Card - Make it in Germany
Bundesagentur für Arbeit - Chancenkarte funds requirement (ZAV newsletter, confirms €1,091/month for 2026)

notes: Funds figure €13,092/year (€1,091/month) confirmed tier-1 via the Bundesagentur für Arbeit directly, not just make-it-in-germany — a stronger sourcing position than most figures in this dataset. The older €1,027/month (2024) figure still circulates on several third-party sites and even lingered on an older make-it-in-germany newsletter dated 01.06.2024 — flagged as stale. Work rights capped at 20 hours/week side work plus 2-week trial employment per employer — modeled here as 'restricted' since the schema's work_rights enum doesn't have a granular hours-based value; the 20-hour figure itself lives only in this note, a real precision gap. family_can_join is false — the Chancenkarte itself does not carry dependant rights; family would need to apply under a separate route. This route structurally resembles UK's High Potential Individual (eligibility-based, no employer sponsor, time-limited, doesn't itself lead to settlement) but is genuinely a job-SEARCH permit rather than a work permit — the entire point is switching to Blue Card or a skilled-worker permit once a job is secured, which is why leads_to_pr is false but switchable_to is populated.
